english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Water
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — asking for water
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for water; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan offers Ms Olivia some water as a guest.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan mời chị Olivia uống nước khi đến chơi.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Olivia, would you like some water? You must be thirsty.
turns.vietnamese: Olivia này, chị uống nước nhé? Chắc chị khát lắm rồi.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, cho tôi xin nhé. Cảm ơn chị.
